svg.title: RNN hidden state composition fading across "The cat sat"
svg.desc: As the RNN processes The, then cat, then sat, the hidden state's composition shows the influence of The shrinking at each step while more recent words dominate, illustrating how early information fades in a vanilla RNN.
svg.text: Illustrative decay — by t=3, "The" has shrunk to a sliver. This is vanishing gradients made visible.
